techStack: React 19, TypeScript ~5.7, Vite 6, Vitest 3 — all modern, ESM-only project
verbatimModuleSyntax: true — type-only imports must use `import type`; already correct in useFilteredProducts.ts
noUnusedLocals / noUnusedParameters enforced — no dead variables may be introduced
Target es2023 — Array spread ([...arr]) and .toSorted() are both available; spread is safest for compatibility
Vitest globals injected — no import needed for describe/it/expect in test files
features: useFilteredProducts.ts is the sole hook combining ProductContext (products array) and FilterContext (debouncedSearch, category, inStockOnly, sortBy)
Hook returns { filteredProducts: Product[], resultCount: number } — interface must stay unchanged (Requirement 5)
Only consumer of useFilteredProducts is ProductListPage.tsx

productFilters.ts provides filterProducts(products, filters) — a correct reference: filters first (search→category→inStock), then spreads and sorts ([...result].sort(...)); NOT currently imported by the hook
FilterContext sortBy default value is 'default' — the hook's sort block is an if/else if so default falls through with no sort applied

tests/derivedStateCorrectness.test.tsx has 4 tests: Tests 1/2/4 set a category then change sortBy in a separate act() — catching both Bug 1 (wrong order) and Bug 3 (missing dep); Test 3 changes sortBy alone with no prior filter change — the sharpest Bug 3 regression
No test explicitly asserts non-mutation (Bug 2), but shared ProductProvider across renderHook calls means Bug 2 can corrupt context state across tests
architecture: src/ layout: api/, assets/, components/, context/, data/, hooks/, pages/, styles/, types/, utils/ — all siblings
useFilteredProducts.ts lives in src/hooks/; imports from ../context/ProductContext and ../context/FilterContext and ../types/product
utils/productFilters.ts is NOT imported by useFilteredProducts.ts — the hook re-implements logic inline
All three bugs are co-located in a single useMemo callback in src/hooks/useFilteredProducts.ts
Current buggy dep array: [products, debouncedSearch, category, inStockOnly] — sortBy consumed inside callback but absent from array
No framework.md conventions doc exists; .planning/ is task-scoped only
All three fixes belong in useFilteredProducts.ts only — no other file requires modification per requirements
edgeCases: sortBy === 'default': no sort branch matches, result passes through as-is; after Bug 2 fix the spread still happens before filter runs — this is safe (spread of full products, then filters reduce it, no sort applied)
Empty filter result + sort: with Bug 1 fixed, sort only runs on the already-filtered subset — sorting an empty array is a no-op, safe

Mutation after sort then filter change: Bug 2 (mutation) permanently corrupts the ProductContext array for ALL consumers; must be fixed before Bug 3 fix (adding sortBy to deps), otherwise every sortBy change immediately re-sorts the already-mutated context array — making corruption visible and irreversible faster

sortBy is the only value missing from deps — products, debouncedSearch, category, inStockOnly are all already present; final dep array must be exactly [products, debouncedSearch, category, inStockOnly, sortBy] (no extras per Requirement 4)

Multiple active filters when sortBy changes: after fixes, sort is always last — filter chain (search→category→inStock) runs first producing a subset, then that subset is spread-copied and sorted; all three filters compose correctly
Test isolation: because Bug 2 can corrupt shared context state across test runs, fixing mutation (Bug 2) is prerequisite to reliable test outcomes

tasks.requirement: Requirement 2 — sorting must not mutate the products array held by ProductContext
tasks.description: In useFilteredProducts.ts, change the bare `products.sort(...)` call to operate on a spread copy. Replace with `[...products].sort(...)` (or `.slice().sort(...)`). This must be done before adding sortBy to the dep array (task-3) so that the newly-triggered recomputations do not repeatedly mutate the context array.

tasks.requirement: Requirement 1 — filtering must be applied before sorting
tasks.description: In useFilteredProducts.ts, restructure the useMemo callback so the three filter steps (debouncedSearch → category → inStockOnly) run first on `products`, producing a filtered subset, and the sort is applied last on that subset. The sort block (if/else if on sortBy) must move to after all filter blocks.

tasks.requirement: Requirements 3 and 4 — sortBy must appear in the useMemo dependency array; all five values must be present with no additions or omissions
tasks.description: In useFilteredProducts.ts, add `sortBy` to the useMemo dependency array. The final dep array must be exactly `[products, debouncedSearch, category, inStockOnly, sortBy]` — no more, no fewer. This is safe to do only after task-1 (mutation fix) is in place.
